declarations.name: reflectedGammaCarrier_zero_arithmeticProgression
declarations.doc: One half of the carrier divisor is a nonconstant arithmetic progression.

declarations.name: ramseyDoubledPhase_quadratures
declarations.doc: Ramsey X/Y tomography reads the cosine and sine of the doubled geometric phase.

declarations.name: arithmeticProgression_zeroCount_lower
declarations.doc: The first `N` points of a nonconstant arithmetic progression are distinct and lie in a disk whose radius grows at most linearly in `N`.

declarations.name: ordered_correlation_of_ramsey_quadratures
declarations.doc: Phase-complete ordered clock tomography.** Any reported characteristic functional whose two Ramsey quadratures agree with those of the controlled pulse family is the pulse family's own characteristic functional, so differentiating the reported data in each coupling recovers the complete ordered correlation.

declarations.name: HasMinimalExponentialType.no_arithmeticProgression_zeros
declarations.doc: An entire function of minimal exponential type, nonzero at one anchor, cannot vanish on every point of a nonconstant arithmetic progression.

declarations.name: chronometricRamseyOrderQuadratures
declarations.doc: Ramsey quadrature data for two opposite operator orderings.

declarations.name: chronometricRamseyPauliX
declarations.doc: Pauli-X readout of the two-level clock.

declarations.name: unitaryCircuitWordSeparated_syndetic_backward_cones
declarations.doc: Operator-norm specialization of syndetic cone propagation in arbitrary unital C⋆-algebras.

declarations.name: dirichletPoly_half_floor_syndetic
declarations.doc: Every nonempty critical-line Dirichlet carrier crosses the fixed floor `1/2` in every interval of one fixed length.

declarations.name: maximallyProjective_commutingGateWordsHardTimes_syndetic
declarations.doc: Semantic specialization: commuting independent gate actions automatically satisfy the trace invariance premise of the syndetic plateau law.

declarations.name: infinitePathPrefix_projectiveReturn_syndetic
declarations.doc: Every literal finite prefix of a simultaneously projective path field has syndetic projective quantum recurrence at every positive resolution.

declarations.name: maximallyProjective_projectiveSpectralCircuitHardTimes_syndetic
declarations.doc: Every maximally projective spectrum reaches fixed-error continuous-circuit hard endpoints syndetically in physical time, for its actual eigenbasis.

declarations.name: maximallyProjective_pureChoiRecurrence_syndetic
declarations.doc: A maximally projective static Choi orbit returns near its initial channel in every interval of one fixed finite length.

declarations.name: dpoly_floor_syndetic_of_diagonal
declarations.doc: A finite Dirichlet polynomial whose diagonal second moment exceeds `t₀²` crosses the floor `t₀` in every interval of one fixed positive length, uniformly in the base height.

declarations.name: maximallyProjective_unitaryEvolution_projectiveReturn_syndetic
declarations.doc: A finite maximally projective Hamiltonian returns, up to global phase, inside every interval of one fixed length at every positive operator-norm resolution.

exploration.name: pauliTraceless_pureChoiTraceHardTimes_syndetic
exploration.doc: Syndetic circuit hardness for the traceless fixed-weight Pauli ensemble.** Below the entropy threshold, hard endpoints of the Choi trajectory occur in every interval of one finite length.

exploration.name: exists_syndetic_lt_of_upperSemicontinuous
exploration.doc: The syndetic clause.** If an upper semicontinuous statistic dips below a level somewhere on the torus, then along a rationally independent phase flow it dips below that level in every interval of one fixed finite length.

exploration.name: maximallyProjective_complete_circuitPolygon_shadow_syndetic
exploration.doc: Autonomous complete-polygon shadowing law.** One fixed maximally projective Hamiltonian shadows every nonidentity vertex of a supplied strict prime-torsion hard polygon and returns near the identity at the prime multiple. Such base times occur with one uniform finite gap after every starting time.

exploration.name: denseAddOrbit_open_hits_syndetically
exploration.doc: Syndetic dense-orbit law.** Let a real one-parameter subgroup have dense range in a compact topological group. Every nonempty open target is hit in every interval of one fixed finite length. No metric, measure, differentiability, finite dimension, or rate assumption is used. The gap length depends on the orbit and target.

exploration.name: maximallyProjective_unitaryEvolution_continuousCircuitHardIntervals_syndetic
exploration.doc: Universal physical hard-interval law.** Every finite Hermitian Hamiltonian with maximally projective spectrum has one fixed positive operator error, one fixed positive plateau width, and one finite recurrence gap such that every gap window contains a full plateau interval excluding every continuous two-qubit circuit with `16s < D - 1`.
